ordo in Ecclesia à Christo constitutus, non debuit esse temporalis, sed
perpetuus. Ut perpetuo usu postea fuit confirmatus, tam sub Impera-

re debuerit. Ut constat eum etiam sub Imperatoribus constanter obtinuisse.

page.notes: The versicle signs "¥" before "3.", "13." and "2." are printed marks and were copied as they appear; their exact form is uncertain. "Expaulo" in the right margin is probably "Ex paulo" with the space lost in print. The main text ends mid-word at "ex"; the catchword "com-" is printed at the foot right. Some letters in the second paragraph are faint from the scan, but all words were legible.
